description:
Thanks Art W For sponsoring this event!  They create beautiful works of art, and they would like to help you paint the army or miniature of your dreams. https://www.artwstudio.com/

===============GAME INFO=============

Mitchell has been chomping at the bit to be able to try out the new Black Templar rules and I think it's high time we relased the beast!  
Michale of course thinks hes found the answer to the Space Marine supiriority complex and brought his necrons to bring the Astartes low.  
Join us for a live adventure into 40k!
